name: RJ Wood Industries

about:
RJ Wood Industries operates from Jackson, Wisconsin, where it produces custom millwork, retail fixtures, and commercial cabinetry. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not disclosed in public materials, and no founders are named on its website or directory listings.

The shop delivers complete project management that spans engineering, drafting, manufacturing, in-house finishing, and installation. Its capabilities cover store fixtures such as showcases, cash wraps, point-of-purchase displays, and trade-show exhibits with custom crating, as well as commercial build-outs including reception counters, factory-built walls, casework, trim packages, bank fixtures, and nurses stations. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

Customers come from retail and commercial construction sectors. Concrete examples include retail chains needing perimeter and loose fixtures, professional office build-outs, financial institutions requiring bank cabinetry, and healthcare facilities ordering nurses stations. The company also serves trade-show exhibitors with custom exhibit fabrication and crating.

RJ Wood Industries emphasizes a turn-key quality product built on strategic customer partnerships and project management. It cites efficient installation methods that reduce on-site labor and keep projects on schedule, along with in-house finish capabilities that control quality from raw material through final delivery.
